scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:2's warning that the followers would be expelled from synagogues and that those who killed them would think they were offering service to God. The figures and setting are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples on a sunlit stone terrace, while several people turn away along a shadowed street and one raises a hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting the opposition Jesus describes and his words that those who do these things have not known the Father or him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation, not a depicted historical incident.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with an open hand to attentive disciples gathered on a stone terrace, beneath a darkening sky over a distant city.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with his disciples evokes his words in John 16:4: he tells them these things so that, when their hour comes, they may remember that he told them; he had not told them from the beginning because he was with them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a sunlit path while a small group of disciples sits nearby listening beneath a tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus telling his listeners that he is going to the One who sent him and that none of them asks where he is going, based on the verse and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to four sorrowful disciples seated together in a lamplit courtyard at dusk.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:6: Jesus has spoken to his listeners, and sorrow has filled their heart. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree, gesturing toward a winding path as a luminous breeze crosses the sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus telling his disciples that his departure is for their benefit and that he will send the Helper to them. The path and breeze are visual symbols, not a literal account of the promised events.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Golden light falls on a gathering in an ancient town square as one man sets down a purse, another returns belongings to a seated woman, and a balance scale stands nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses light, a returned purse, an act of kindness, and a balance as visual metaphors for the verse's words about convicting the world concerning sin, righteousness, and judgment. The pictured events are not stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends an open hand toward a group of hesitant people in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting people turning away or hesitating before Jesus, reflecting the verse’s words concerning sin and not believing in him. The pictured encounter is not presented as a recorded event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks up a sunlit path toward a radiant sky while a group of followers watches from a rocky hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:10's words about righteousness, Jesus going to the Father, and his followers no longer seeing him. The path and light are visual metaphors, not a literal depiction of the manner or setting of his departure.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A dark-robed ruler bows beside a fallen crown on a rocky hillside, overlooking a sunlit city and fields beneath breaking clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative symbolic scene of a ruler whose fallen crown and bowed posture suggest the verse's statement that the ruler of this world has been judged; the landscape and figure are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently with open hands to a group of thoughtful disciples seated among warm stone walls, with hills and trees beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:12: Jesus has many things still to say, while his listeners cannot bear them now. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of travelers listen to one another on a hillside path as luminous currents of air sweep toward a sunlit valley and distant horizon.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 16:13: the light and winding path suggest the Spirit of truth guiding the listeners, while the distant horizon evokes things yet to come.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed speaker sits beneath a tree among attentive listeners as golden light flows from him toward them, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses light flowing from the speaker to the listeners to suggest the verse's promise that what is his will be disclosed to them, bringing him glory. The light and setting are artistic metaphors, not details stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he teaches an attentive group in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses shared sunlight as a metaphor for the verse's description of what belongs to the Father and the Son being taken and disclosed to the listeners. The courtyard and gathering are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive disciples beneath a tree in a sunlit landscape, while a winding path passes a rocky hill toward distant light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 16:16: the winding path suggests the little while when Jesus will no longer be seen and the little while after which he will be seen again. The setting is an artistic interpretation, not a detail specified in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four disciples gesture and look thoughtfully toward Jesus as they sit beneath a tree near a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples discussing Jesus' words about seeing him again after a little while and his going to the Father, as described in John 16:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people in ancient clothing gather beneath a tree, exchanging puzzled looks and open-handed gestures in a sunlit village landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of people questioning what “a little while” means and admitting they do not understand what he is saying, as described in John 16:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he speaks to five attentive disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus addressing the disciples as they wonder about his words that they would not see him for a little while and would then see him again. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A small group weeps and comforts one another beneath a tree, while people celebrate in the distance and sunlight breaks through the clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 16:20: those addressed will weep and grieve while the world rejoices, and their grief will turn to joy. The sunlight suggests the promised joy.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling, weary mother cradles her swaddled newborn in a sunlit room while a caring woman sits beside her; a peaceful landscape is visible through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the joy after childbirth in John 16:21, when the arrival of a child into the world eclipses the memory of anguish.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a joyful group of followers on a sunlit stone path beside an olive tree; one reaches toward him while another smiles through tears.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative reunion expresses the verse's movement from present grief to seeing again and a joy no one can take away; the setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with seated disciples in a sunlit courtyard; one disciple looks upward with open hands.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus’ words about asking the Father in his name; the courtyard and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks warmly to a group of disciples in a sunlit courtyard; one raises open hands as the others listen with joyful expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' invitation to ask in his name and receive, so that their joy may be full.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive disciples on a sunlit stone terrace, with mist receding among distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evokes Jesus' promise that an hour is coming when he will speak plainly about the Father rather than in allegories. The setting and visual metaphor are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group of disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard; one disciple raises open hands in prayer.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 16:26: Jesus tells his followers that in that day they will ask in his name, and does not say he will implore the Father for them. The courtyard and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to attentive followers gathered in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath leafy vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus telling his followers that the Father loves them because they have loved him and believed that he came from God. The warm light suggests the Father’s love; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks along a sunlit path away from an ancient village, looking toward the bright horizon over a valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a journey toward light to suggest Jesus leaving the world and going to the Father, from whom he came; it is not a literal depiction of the event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with his disciples as one speaks to him with open hands and the others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples telling Jesus that he is speaking openly and no longer using allegory, as described in John 16:29.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree with disciples gathered around him; one speaks with open hands while the others listen, with hills, water, and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the disciples expressing their belief that Jesus knows all things and came from God, inspired by John 16:30 and its Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits outdoors and speaks with an open hand to a group of attentive listeners beneath a tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering them with the question, ‘Now do you believe?’ The setting and expressions are artistic choices; the English glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in warm evening light at a fork in a rocky path while disciples walk away in different directions toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Jesus saying that his disciples would scatter and leave him, yet he is not alone because the Father is with him. The landscape and gentle light are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks gently to a group of disciples gathered in a sunlit clearing, while a rainstorm darkens the distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene uses the contrast between sunlight and a distant storm to suggest the peace, tribulation, courage, and overcoming of the world in John 16:33. The setting and weather are artistic choices.
